brief:
The Palestinian Investment Fund seeks to broaden its partnership with the private sector and strengthen its role in the national economy, according to Ma'an Wire. The fund aims to deepen collaboration mechanisms that would give the private sector a greater voice in shaping economic policy and development initiatives.

The expansion effort reflects efforts to integrate private enterprise more fully into Palestinian economic planning and growth strategy.

title: Palestinian Investment Fund expands private sector partnership plan
